Job Description


Experience : 4+ Yrs till 12 Yrs
Grade : B2 / C1 /C2
Location : Pune/Bangalore/Chennai/Hyderabad Only
Notice period : 0-30 days Aug Joiner Only


NOTE:- Very Strong Python Backend Experience Required, L1 Round is Hackerrank Test so while talking to candidates take there availability for test on Saturday they will get link to complete test If select then there will be L2 Round as Final round


JD Preferred :-

Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Experience in designing and developing REST APIs.
Strong knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and ORM frameworks.
Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis) is a plus.
Knowledge of microservices architecture and API integrations.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployments.
Understanding of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
